Molly is a lovely 13-year-old girl looking for a comfortable, loving home to enjoy her golden years. Molly loves her walks and would be delighted to have someone to enjoy her outings with, taking in all the wonderful sights and smells along the way. Molly could live with primary school-aged children. Molly can be left for up to a couple of hours once she has settled in, provided this is built up gradually to help her feel safe and comfortable being on her own. Molly is also a great traveller and is good in the car, making her the perfect companion for little adventures and trips out!

Molly is an older lady looking for a quiet, peaceful home. She enjoys gentle walks and long naps, and she'd be perfectly happy settling into a cosy home or office during the day with a comfortable bed, plenty of fuss, and lots of attention. She is currently trying to lose a little weight, so she can be quite vocal if she suspects treats might be nearby! When treats aren’t on her mind, she's a calm and quiet companion who enjoys watching the world go by.

name: Ava
description:
Ava is a 7 month old Pointer X Spaniel. She is a friendly girl who could join a home with children of Primary School age and older who are confident around bouncy dogs as she may jump up when excited. Ava has been able to mix both on and off lead with other dogs and has the potential to live with another dog pending meets at the centre. She would benefit from a garden to provide space for play and housetraining however this is not essential if ample alternative outlets for exercise are provided. Once settled, leaving hours could be built up.

Ava is a sweet, young girl looking for an active family that can help teach her the basics and give her the time and exercise she needs. She will make a wonderful companion for her new family.

name: Peach
description:
Meet Peach!  Peach is a sweet and friendly girl with a gentle soul.  When she first arrived with us, she was a very nervous girl and found the change quite overwhelming.  She is beginning to gain confidence and is starting to enjoy fuss, affection and attention from the people around her.  She will need a patient, understanding home that is happy to give her the time and reassurance she needs to feel safe and secure.  Peach can be quite vocal in her kennel when left alone, so her new adopter will need to be prepared to work on this with her, gradually building up her confidence and introducing her to being left for short periods.  She will need time to settle into her new surroundings and establish a routine, so a home where she isn’t expected to be left alone for long periods initially would be ideal.  On the plus side, Peach loves her walks and enjoys getting out and about exploring, and she does like the sound of her own voice while she’s out, a typical talkative Hound.  She will need an active home that can provide plenty of exercise, adventures and mental stimulation.  Experience with the breed would be preferred, as an understanding of their characteristics and needs would be a real bonus.  Peach is looking for someone who will be patient, kind and willing to let her blossom at her own pace.  With time, love and understanding this lovely girl will grow in confidence and become the happy, secure companion she deserves to be.  She will need a private secure garden.

Peach has interacted with other dogs while in our care.  In typical Hound fashion she can be very vocal and barky around them, but once she has met them she does settle down.  We feel she could potentially live with another dog of similar size following a successful meet and greet. (must be neutered).

As Peach came into the home as a stray, we have no previous history on her, so we would prefer any children in the home to be 14+ years.

name: Mowgli
description:
Meet marvellous Mowgli!  Mowgli is a gorgeous boy and is now looking for a special home to call his own.  When Mowgli first came into our care, his coat was in a very poor condition.  He was extremely matted and had lots of bald patches, meaning he needed to be shaved and placed on a medical shampoo treatment.  Fast forward 3 months and thankfully, his fur is now growing back beautifully, and he’s looking and feeling much better.  However, his future adopter must be prepared for the ongoing grooming and coat care that his breed requires.  Regular brushing and maintenance will be essential to keep him comfortable and looking his best.  Mowgli is a real attention lover.  He absolutely adores a fuss and isn’t shy about asking for it.  He can jump up when he’s looking for attention, so this is something his new adopter will need to be mindful of and work with him on.  Mowgli is also quite the escape artist!  He will look for any opportunity to make a dash for freedom, particularly when the staff are entering and leaving his kennel, so secure handling and extra care around doors and gates will be essential.  He can sometimes become a little whiny and stressed in the kennel environment, so our staff do their best to get him out as often as possible for some lovely walks.  This is where we really see him relax and settle.  He seems much happier once he’s out and about, enjoying his walks or chasing around our secure compound.  Mowgli is looking for a home with someone who ideally has previous experience of the breed and someone who is committed to regular grooming and ongoing coat maintenance.  A home that understands the importance of secure doors, gates and careful handling to prevent any escape attempts.  Mowgli is a lovely boy with so much affection to give.  We would love to find him an experienced, understanding home that can give him the time, care and attention he deserves.  He will need a private secure garden.

Mowgli has interacted with other dogs while in our care and doesn’t seem to bothered with them he would much rather have human attention, so for this reason we would like him to be the only dog in the home.

As Mowgli came into the home as a stray we have no previous history on him so would prefer any children in the home to be 16+ years.

name: Daisy
description:
Meet Daisy! She is a friendly, sweet-natured girl who absolutely loves her cuddles and enjoys being around people.  Daisy has a lovely playful side too and can often be found having a good old run around our secure compound, chasing after her favourite toys and enjoying some classic Greyhound zoomies!  Daisy walks nicely on the lead and is a pleasure to take out.  She also loves being groomed, happily enjoying all the attention and fuss.  Like many ex-racing greyhounds, Daisy has never lived in a home before, so her new adopter will need to give her time, patience and understanding while she learns all about home life.  House training, new routines, household noises and settling into a new environment will all be a completely new experience for her, with kindness, consistency and plenty of reassurance, Daisy can begin to discover just how wonderful life as a much-loved pet can be.  When she gets over excited, Daisy can be a little mouthy, so her new adopter will need to help her learn appropriate ways to express her excitement.  Daisy is a fun-loving, affectionate girl with plenty of personality.  She loves to play, enjoys cuddles and is ready to leave her racing days behind and start the next chapter of her life.  Daisy has so much love and fun to give and is looking forward to finding a special family she can call her own.  Daisy will need a private secure garden so she can safely have off lead time.

Daisy was previously rehomed a few weeks ago but unfortunately has been brought back to us.  It was reported that she has been growling at their teenage daughter.  There was no reported malice, but this is something we feel needs to be managed appropriately in her next home, preferably with adopters that have had ex racing greyhounds previously and understand  that she will need lots of time to settle, who will respect her boundaries and allow her to learn at her own pace.

Daisy has socialised well with other dogs whilst in our care, so we feel she could potentially live with another dog of similar size following a successful meet and greet.

We are looking for an adult only home for her that has Greyhound experience.

name: Godiva
description:
Meet Godiva!  Godiva is an incredibly sweet, friendly and lively little girl who absolutely adores attention.  She’s a real sweetheart who loves nothing more than fuss, cuddles and being close to her favourite people.  She’s not shy about asking for attention either.  Godiva can get quite excited and does jump up so say hello and make sure she’s getting all the fuss she deserves.  She’s also more than happy to climb onto your lap for cuddles.  The staff absolutely adore her and describe her as an adorable little angel – and it’s easy to see why.  Godiva is looking for a loving home where she’ll be included as part of the family and given plenty of affection, attention and nice walks exploring.  Previous Dachshund experience would be an advantage, as an understanding of the breed and their little quirks will help Godiva settle into her new home.  If you’re looking for a loving, affectionate little companion with plenty of character, Godiva could be the girl for you!  She will need a private secure garden.

Godiva has socialised with other dogs while in our care and isn’t too bothered about them, so we feel she would be best rehomed as the only dog in the home.

As Godiva came into the home as a stray, we have no previous history on her so would prefer any children in the home to be 14+ years.

name: Sprout
description:
Meet Sprout!  Sprout is a very friendly, affectionate and loving little character who is full of life and bursting with energy.  He is a very giddy, playful boy who loves having fun and enjoys nothing more that chasing around our secure compound, letting off steam and enjoying himself. He has a real zest for life and would make a wonderful companion for someone who enjoys an active, fun-loving dog.  Sprout is full of personality and loves attention and affection.  He is still a young boy with lots to learn, so he will need a home willing to put time and patience into his basic training and help him develop into the best boy he can be.  He currently urinates in his bed, so this is something his new adopter will need to work on with patience, consistency and a good toilet-training routine.  Sprout is looking for a loving, committed home that can match his energy, give him lots of exercise, attention and enrichment, while also helping him learn and settle into a routine.  He has so much love and fun to bring to a home.  With the right people willing to guide him, we’re sure this handsome little lad has the potential to make a fantastic lifelong companion.  He will need a private secure garden.

Sprout has socialised with other dogs while in our care.  Some he’s happy to have a sniff at and can get a bit giddy and others he will avoid.  We feel he would be best rehomed as the only dog in the home where he can continue his socialisation around other dogs at his own pace.

As Sprout came into us as a stray, we have no previous history on him so would prefer any children in the home to be 14+ years.

name: Tori
description:
Meet Tori!  Tori is a lovely, friendly young girl who is full of life, personality and energy! At just 18 months old, Tori is still very much a youngster and has plenty to learn.  She is an affectionate, enthusiastic girl who loves getting out and about, but she will need a very special home that understands her needs and can keep up with her busy lifestyle.  Tori is an extremely energetic girl who can sometimes be quite a handful.  She loves spending time in our secure compound, where she can chase her favourite balls and burn off some of that endless energy.  She also thoroughly enjoys long walks, exploring her surroundings and taking in all the sights and smells along the way.  Kennel life can be difficult for Tori.  She can be whiny and vocal, and she has been known to jump over the kennel walls.  She also chews toys and bedding and does get very frustrated.  A German Shepherd needs more than just three walks a day.  They are an intelligent working breed who thrive when they have a purpose.  They need a job to do, both mentally and physically, and will benefit from activities that challenge their minds as well as exercise their bodies.  Whether that’s scent work, training, tracking, problem-solving games, enrichment activities or learning new skills, they need to be kept occupied and given an outlet for their natural instincts. Tori needs an adopter who understands a tired mind is just as important as a tired body.  She will need an experienced adopter who has worked with the breed before.  Tori needs a secure private garden and someone who is around most of the day.  Please only apply if you have the experience and commitment to give Tori what she needs.

Tori has socialised with other dogs while in our care and can be very vocal and does get frustrated around them.  So we feel she would be best rehomed as the only dog where her committed owner will continue her socialisation around other dogs in a controlled environment with lots of positive reinforcement.

As Tori came into the home as a stray, we have no previous history on her, so would prefer any children/visiting children in the home to be 16+ years.

name: Sox
description:
Meet Sox! Sox is a lovely girl with a heart full of love and plenty of personality.  She adores lots of fuss and attention.  If she spots an empty lap, you can guarantee she’ll be straight on it. Sox is a clever girl and knows her basic commands, including her very own fancy spin! Sox can be quite a vocal lady, especially when she’s in her kennel or trying to let you know she’d like her ball thrown or a tasty treat.  She loves playing with her toys, chasing after them and having a good time.  She’s also a big fan of her walks, enjoying longer walks where she can explore and take in all the lovely smells along the way.  Sox really is a lovely-natured girl with so much love to give.  Once thing to be aware of is that’s she’s a little worried about being brushed, so she’ll need someone patient and gentle to help her build confidence with grooming.  She is looking for a loving home where she can enjoy plenty of fuss, adventures, playtime and, of course, a comfy lap to call her own!  Sox would benefit from a private secure garden so she can safely have off-lead time chasing around with her toys.

Sox has interacted with other dogs while in our care and she has no interest in them, so we feel she would be best rehomed as the only dog in the home.

As Sox came into us as a stray, we have no previous history on her, so would prefer any children in the home to be 14+ years.

name: Garfunkel
description:
Meet Garfunkel!  Garfunkel is looking for a special home to call his own!  He can be a little nervous and unsure of new people and situations at first, but give him a little time and his personality soon begins to shine through.  Once he gets to know you, he’s a very friendly, playful and excitable boy who loves to have fun and show off his cheeky character.  He can certainly make himself heard and is quite the vocal boy in his kennel, so you’ll never be in any doubt when Garfunkel wants to say something.  Garfunkel has a few funny little quirks too.  He enjoys having a good rag of his blankets, loves to chew his toys and likes to rearrange his water bowl to keep himself entertained.  He can also be worried by the cleaning equipment when staff are cleaning his kennel, so they have to be mindful of this and give him the reassurance and space he needs.  Garfunkel would benefit from an understanding home that will allow him time to settle in and get comfortable at his own pace.  Previous Bulldog experience would be an advantage, as someone familiar with the breed will be better placed to understand his needs and character.  Underneath his initially unsure exterior is a friendly, fun-loving and playful boy with lots of personality.  He will need continued training and socialisation and would benefit from a private secure garden.

Garfunkel has interacted with other dogs while in our care and isn’t interested in then so we feel he would be best rehomed as the only dog in the home where he can get 100% of the love and attention.

As Garfunkel came into the home as a stray, we have no previous history on him so would prefer any children in the home to be 14+ years.

name: Rufus
description:
Meet Rufus our gorgeous goofball! (46kg).  He is looking for an experienced home where he can continue to learn and enjoy all the love and attention he deserves.  When Rufus first arrived, he was a nervous boy and could be a bit growly while he found his feet.  However, he has now come out of his shell and what a character he is!  He’s a friendly and affectionate lad who absolutely loves a fuss and being around people.  Rufus is a big boy with an equally big personality.  He’s giddy, playful and full of enthusiasm.  He loves his toys and often likes to carry two around in his mouth at once.  He also has a habit of using your leg as a handy resting place for his toys while he is playing with them, unfortunately he doesn’t always realise when he is chewing his toy that he has nipped legs by accident on occasion.  One thing potential adopters really need to be aware of is Rufus’s strength.   He is very strong on the lead and does pull a lot.  He will need further lead training and an experienced handler who is physically capable of managing large, powerful and boisterous dog.  Rufus can also become a little mouthy when he’s overexcited, so he’ll need someone who understands this behaviour and is happy to continue working on his manners and impulse control.  Rufus is looking for an experienced owner who has previously owned large, strong and energetic dogs.  An owner committed to ongoing training, particularly lead manners, excitement management and learning appropriate boundaries.  Someone who understands that his size and enthusiasm can sometimes get the better of him.  Rufus has so much potential and, underneath all that strength and silliness, there’s an affectionate boy who wants to enjoy life and be someone’s special companion.  He will need a private secure garden.

Rufus has socialised well with other dogs while in our care, but we feel he would be best rehomed as the only dog in the home where he can get 100% of the attention and training he needs.

As Rufus came into the home as a stray, we have no previous history on him so would prefer any children/visiting children in the home to be 16+ years.

name: Albie
description:
Albie is a lovely boy with a big personality and lots of love to give.  He is a very friendly, affectionate and excitable boy who loves being around people and getting plenty of attention.  He can be a real giddy lad and, when he’s excited, he does jump up for attention and can be a bit mouthy.  He is also very vocal in his kennel.  With his high energy levels, Albie will need an active home where he can enjoy plenty of exercise, long walks and adventures.  He absolutely loves getting out and about, exploring his surroundings and taking in all the interesting smells.  He is quite strong on the lead so will need continued lead training.  He also enjoys playing with his toys, although he prefers to play on his own with them and will chase around our compound proudly showing you what he has got.

Albie does know some basic commands, but will benefit from further training and guidance to help him develop into the best version of himself.  His new adopter will need to continue working on his manners, particularly around jumping up and mouthing when over-excited.  Ongoing socialisation will also be important for him.  As well as physical exercise, Albie will need plenty of mental stimulation to keep his clever and energetic mind occupied.  Enrichment, training games, interactive toys and learning new skills would all be great ways to help him burn off some of that enthusiasm.  Albie is looking for an active and committed home that will enjoy his fun-loving personality, give him plenty of exercise and enrichment, and be willing to continue his training and socialisation.  In return, he has plenty of affection, enthusiasm and fun to offer.  Albie will need a private secure garden.

Albie can be rehomed with children who are 16 years and over due to his bouncy nature – subject to a successful meet.

Albie prefers his own space so we believe he is best being the only dog in the home. He will happily say hello to dogs when he is out on walks.

Please do not apply for a dog if you have a holiday within the next 3 months.

name: Apollo
description:
Apollo arrived into our care as a stray he was very reserved and shy. He was very unsure of new people, a lead and going for walks. With some love and attention he is now slowly starting to realise that the world isn’t such a scary place. He is still a little unsure of new surroundings so will need a patient home that has time to help him settle in. As he is gaining confidence he is starting to be a very affectionate boy with both staff and volunteers. He is full on and loves to jump all over you and give you lots of kisses!

Apollo needs a calm home with a patient family that has the time to allow him to settle into a new environment. He may need basic training once he has settled and his personality starts to come through. He is going to be a fantastic companion with the right home and a lot time. Apollo needs a home that has owned dogs previously.

Apollo can be rehomed with children who are 16 years and over – subject to a successful meet.

Apollo has interacted well with dogs whilst out on walks, he is very gentle and calm, so he could potentially be rehomed with another dog – subject to a successful meet.

Please do not apply for a dog if you have a holiday within the next 3 months.

attributes.Breed: Staffordshire Bull Terrier x Border Collie

name: Lucy
description:
Lucy came into our care through no fault of her own, along with her puppies. The puppies have all been rehomed now and after some patience, love and care Lucy is now ready to find her forever home. She is still very shy and scared if she doesn’t know you and will shout at you if you visit her in her kennel. Once she knows you, outside of the kennel, she is a very affectionate girl. She gets very excited to see you, so will jump all over you. She likes her treats which is a good way to help her build her confidence around new people. Lucy loves a run around in the compound area or walks in the woods. She is going to need an active family and plenty of mental stimulation to keep her occupied.

Lucy is looking for a very experienced home, with a family that have had nervous rescue dogs before. She is going to need a lot of patience and potential adopters are going to need to be able to commit to multiple meets before she goes home. Lucy is still just a young dog herself so will need all of the basic training and socialisation when she goes home. Lucy has the potential to be a lovely family dog but she does require time and work to help her reach this point.

Due to her being so nervous she needs to be in an adult only home with no visiting children.

Lucy has socialised well with dogs and loves a friend to go on walks with her. She can be very full on and over the top with dogs so would benefit from some further training to teach her some manners. We do believe that she can potentially be rehomed with another dog, it would have to be patient, gentle and of a similar size – subject to a successful meet.

Please do not apply for a dog if you have a holiday within the next 3 months.

name: Arlo
description:
Arlo is a gorgeous, sweet-natured boy who is very friendly and absolutely loves lots of fuss.  He’s a real people dog and enjoys getting plenty of attention and affection.  He is a very energetic and boisterous lad who can get extremely giddy when he’s excited.  He sometimes forgets just how big he is and will jump up to say hello, so he would benefit from some basic training to help him learn his manners and channel all that enthusiasm. Arlo loves running around in our compound area, getting out lots of energy with a case of the zoomies! Arlo is a loveable, fun, lively character with bags of personality.  He would thrive in a very active home with someone who can give him plenty of exercise, long walks and consistency with his training.  He would need a private secure garden so he can practice his zoomies!

Arlo has interacted well with dogs whilst in our care but can be very boisterous and jumpy, he could potentially be rehomed with a dog of a similar size and temperament – subject to a successful meet.

Arlo is best suited to be rehomed with children who are 16 years and over – subject to his successful meet.

Please do not apply for a dog if you have a holiday within the next 3 months.

name: Reggie
description:
Meet Reggie!  Reggie is a handsome young boy with a big personality and plenty of character!  Reggie is a friendly boy who enjoys interaction and playtime, but he is also a strong-minded lad who will need an experienced owner who understands his breed and can provide clear boundaries, consistency and guidance.  Reggie can become nippy when excited or overstimulated, so his new home will need to be mindful of his arousal levels and understand how to manage and redirect this behaviour appropriately.  He is also very vocal during play, so don’t be surprised if he has plenty to say!  He has some quirky behaviours too.  He loves chasing the hosepipe while staff are cleaning his kennel and can get quite enthusiastic and does rag his bedding.  His new adopter will need to show him how to channel that frustration.  Reggie can be quite dominant and has previously shown some possessive behaviour around his bed, standing over it while staff have attempted to move it.  He also displays some unusual body language at times, although he has been ok with staff during his time in our care.  We are looking for an experienced, confident and patient owner who can recognise and understand his body language, respect his boundaries and work positively with him to help him develop good manners and appropriate behaviours.  Reggie is still a young dog with lots to learn, and with the right home, consistent handling and ongoing training, we know he can continue to make progress.  He isn’t going to be the right match for everyone, but we believe the right person will see the lovely character behind this cheeky little Frenchie.  He will need a private secure garden.

Reggie has interacted with other dogs while in our care and is very humpy with them so we feel he would be best rehomed as the only dog in the home.

As Reggie came into the home as a stray, we have no previous history on him so would prefer any children in the home to be 16+ years.

name: Fizz
description:
Meet Fizz!  Fizz is a beautiful girl with a big personality and bags of character.  She is a friendly, excitable and very playful little lady who is always ready to bring a bit of fun and mischief wherever she goes.  She’s a sassy girl who knows her own mind and certainly isn’t short of personality.  Fizz absolutely loves human company and thrives on attention.  She’s a girl who enjoys being involved in everything and will jump up to say hello and demand some fuss.  She would benefit from continued gentle guidance with her manners and to be shown there are calmer ways to say hello.  When she gets a little overexcited, she does gently nibble at your fingers, but this is all part of her excited and playful nature and is done without any malice.  She’s a giddy, fun-loving girl who loves her walks and enjoys getting out and about to explore.  Whether it’s playtime, walkies or simply spending time with her favourite people. Fizz is happiest when she’s getting attention and being part of the action.  Fizz is looking for a home that will embrace her cheeky character, enjoy her playful ways and give her all the love, time and attention she deserves.  She will need continued guidance on how to manager her excitement.  She would benefit from a private secure garden.

Fizz has interacted with other dogs while in our care, and although she is happy to walk along side them she doesn’t like them in her face or sniffing around her back end so we feel she would be best rehomed as the only dog in the home.

As Fizz came into the home as a stray, we have no previous history on her so would prefer any children in the home to be 14+ years.

name: Darren
description:
Darren came into our care as a stray so we don’t have any background information about him. He is looking for a very special home with someone who truly understands the unique personality and characteristics of the Shar – Pei Breed. Like many Shar -Pei’s, he is an independent character who enjoys doing things on his own terms. He isn’t fussed about being handled, fussed over or touched and prefers his own personal space respected. He needs an understanding owner who can recognise his body language, respect his boundaries and give him time to build trust at his own pace. Whilst he may not be a cuddly, affectionate dog, he has his own personality and charm.

He really enjoys getting out on walks and it’s great to see him perk up with excitement as soon as he spots the lead, it certainly is the highlight of his day! He is strong on the lead and does pull a lot so he will need more work in this area. He has socialised well with dogs out on walks and has shown that he can be comfortable out in  a group.

Darren needs an experienced adult only home, with no visiting children.

Darren is best suited to being the only dog in the home so he can have his own space.

Please do not apply for a dog if you have a holiday within the next 3 months.

name: Theo
description:
Meet Theo! Theo has a big heart and plenty of love to give.  This friendly, affectionate boy absolutely thrives on attention, and the more fuss and cuddles he gets, the happier he is!  Theo loves getting out and about on walks (he does walk better on a harness) but his favourite time of days is his off-lead time in our secure compound where he can run around and chase his favourite toys.  He does know some basic commands like sit, paw and speak and is very eager to please.  Theo can bark to get your attention and tends to jump up when he gets excited.  He will benefit from a family who can continue working with him on his manners and help him learn calmer ways to ask for attention.  Theo is a fun-loving affectionate boy who has so much love to give.  He would love a home where he can enjoy his walks, have plenty of playtime and, most importantly, receive all the love and attention he deserves.  Theo will need a private secure garden so he can safely have off-lead time with his toys.

Theo has socialised with other dogs while in our care, he will have a quick sniff but isn’t too bothered about them, so we feel he would be happiest being the only dog in the home where he can receive 100% of the attention and cuddles.

Theo has a Grade 1 Heart Murmur, this will be discussed in more detail with the successful applicant.

As Theo came into us as a stray we have no previous history on him, so would prefer any children in the home to be 14+ years.

name: Frank
description:
Frank is a sweet-natured boy who absolutely loves people and enjoys being the centre of attention.  He is a very giddy and excitable character, and his enthusiasm can sometimes get the better of him!  Frank loves treats and is always keen to show off what he knows.  He has his basic commands and is eager to learn, especially when there’s a tasty reward involved.  He can be quite vocal in his kennel, and when excited he can become a little mouthy.  He also loves attention and will jump up to say hello, so his new adopter will need to be comfortable helping him learn some calmer ways to greet people.

Frank is a strong boy on the lead and will need continued training and guidance with his lead manners.  He is an active dog who needs plenty of exercise as well as mental stimulation to keep his busy mind occupied.  Frank is looking for an active and committed home where his new family can give him the exercise, enrichment, training and attention he needs.  His ideal home will be one where his adopters understand that he is an excitable, energetic boy and are prepared to work with him on his manners and impulse control.  In return, Frank has so much affection and enthusiasm to give.  He will need a private secure garden.

We think that Frank can be rehomed with dog savvy children who are 16 years and over due to his size and strength – subject to a successful meet.

Frank has interacted well with dogs whilst in our care so we feel that he could potentially be rehomed with another dog of a similar size and temperament – subject to a successful meet.

Please do not apply for a dog if you have a holiday within the next 3 months.

name: Jax
description:
Jax is a friendly and affectionate boy who absolutely loves attention and enjoys a good fuss.  He has a wonderful nature and is always happy to spend time with his people. This clever lad is exceptionally well behaved at the vets, taking examinations and handling in his stride, which is a testament to his temperament and trainability.  Like many dogs, he has his own little quirks – one of his favourites is enthusiastically ragging his blankets and rearranging them to his liking!

As a typical Belgian Malinois, he is highly intelligent, energetic and thrives on both physical exercise and mental stimulation.  He loves charging around our compound and would be happiest in a home where he has plenty of opportunities to stay active and engaged.  Jax is very ball focused which is a bonus when it comes to training. Because of his breed traits, he will need an owner who has previous experience with Belgian Malinois and understands their needs.  He is not a dog that will be content with a short walk around the block, he requires ongoing training, enrichment and a lifestyle that allows him to use both his body and brain.  He will need a private secure garden.

We feel that it would be best for Jax to be rehomed with adults only.

Jax is a typical Mali so likes to be vocal around other dogs, he is easily distracted with toys but we feel like he would be best suited to being the only dog in the home so he can have his own space and the focus on him.

No cats or small furries for Jax due to having a very high prey drive. We would recommend not having any cats within your area.

Please do not apply for a dog if you have a holiday within the next 3 months.

name: Pearl
description:
Pearl came into our care as a stray so we don’t have much of a history on her. She can be a little vocal around people at first but soon warms up with treats. She is a very sweet gentle girl when she knows you and loves a good fuss. Pearl is an old girl so is looking for a calm, quiet loving home to spend the rest of her years. Pearl loves to curl up under a blanket to keep warm after a nice walk with lots of sniffing. She is still eager to go for a walk and does also enjoy a good run around our enclosed compound area when she has the chance. She loves a boomer ball! Pearl is very food motivated which is a bonus for getting to know her. Pearl would be best suited to a home that has owned a Frenchie before. Due to her older age she does have a few health issues that can be discussed further if you are successful.

We think that Pearl would be best suited to an adult only home.

Pearl has interacted well with dogs whilst in our care, so she can potentially be rehomed with another dog- subject to a successful meet. This dog will need to be of a similar size and a calm  temperament.

name: Mavis
description:
Mavis came into our care as a stray so we don’t have any history on her. She is a typical Frenchie that likes her own way, especially around new people. She is quite protective of her kennel so will shout at you if you come near her. Out on a walk she is much more confident and can be handled. She is just a cheeky girl! She does like attention and a fuss, on her terms, once she gets to know you. She has the potential to be a very loving companion, she just needs the right home that has the patience to allow her to settle down into a new environment. She may need some basic training once she gets home as we are not sure if she has lived in a home before. Mavis needs an experienced home, either with the breed or with nervous rescue dogs.

Mavis needs to be in an adult only home, no visiting children.

Mavis has socialised well with dogs whilst in our care but we believe she would be best suited to being the only dog in the home.

Please do not apply for a dog if you have a holiday within the next 3 months.

name: Dean
description:
Dean is a very friendly boy, he likes to say hello to everyone he meets and loves a fuss. He was a little nervous when he first came in though, it has taken some time for him to reach this point. He loves his toys and can play independently with them in his kennel, he has a favourite toy here which is a string of sausages! He’s a big foody and loves all kinds of tasty snacks. He also enjoys his walks around the woods taking in all of the different smells. With him being a stray there is a possibility that he’s never lived in a home before so some training might be needed to help settle him in. Experience with Frenchie’s is preferred, as they usually have cheeky personalities once they have settled.

Dean needs to be the only dog in the home. He needs continuous socialisation training around dogs to help build his confidence as he can be a little snappy and unsure of new dogs. He has little dog syndrome! His new family must be committed to taking him to training classes.

Dean is best suited to be rehomed with children who are 16 years and over – subject to a successful meet.

name: Ronnie
description:
Ronnie was very nervous and shut down when he first arrived, very unsure of everyone and didn’t know who he could trust. With time and patients from staff, Ronnie is now a completely different dog. He is a super happy boy, who absolutely loves everyone he meets. As soon as he sees you he’s instantly wiggly and gets all giddy. Ronnie brings a smile to everyone’s face with his amazing personality.

With Ronnie having lots of energy and being super playful, he is looking for an active home. His new home must be an adult only home, due to how nervous he was initial here at the home.

We don’t believe Ronnie would be suitable to live with cats or small animals.

Whilst in our care, Ronnie has socialised really well with other dogs. Therefore, we believe he could potentially live with another dog of a similar temperament and able to deal with his craziness – subject to a successful meet.

Please do not apply for a dog if you have a holiday within the next 3 months.

name: Wayne
description:
Wayne will do anything for a good cuddle, he is a super affectionate boy who loves all the attention. He is very giddy and gets very excited when he sees you and even more excited when it’s time for his walk. Wayne can jump up with excitement, so would benefit from further training with this. As he is still a young boy, he is looking for an active home able to give him the exercise he requires.

Since being in our care, Wayne has socialised well with other dogs and enjoys their company whilst out on walks. Therefore, we do believe he could potentially live with another dog of a similar temperament and able to keep up with his craziness – subject to a successful meet.

We don’t have any previous history on Wayne as he sadly came into our care as a stray. We believe he could potentially live with children no younger than 14 years old – subject to a successful meet.

Wayne wouldn’t be suitable to live with cats or small animals.

Please do not apply for a dog if you have a holiday within the next 3 months.

name: Merida
description:
Merida came into our care as stray, therefore we don’t have any previous history on her. When she first arrived at the home, Merida was very nervous and a shy girl. She slowly started to trust staff but can still be nervous and unsure when meeting new people, especially men. Merida is looking for a very patient home, who are understanding and must be committed to do multiple meets here at the home.

Once out of her shell and is confident with you, she’s an absolute sweetheart. Full of life and energy. She thoroughly enjoys being outside on her daily walks. Merida is also super playful, always enjoying time in our enclosed area, playing with toys and staff. Her new family must be active and happy to take her on new adventures.

Whilst being in our care, Merida prefers her own space with other dogs and doesn’t like to be bothered by them. For this reason, she would be best suited to a home with no other dogs. Her new family must be willing to continue with her socialising.

Due to her nervousness, Merida is needing an adult only home, with no visiting children either. She needs a quieter home where she can settle at her pace and feel comfortable. Her new home must be experience and ideally dealt with nervous dogs before.

Please do not apply for a dog if you have a holiday within the next 3 months.

name: Rambo
description:
Meet Rambo!  He is a gorgeous boy with a heart full of love.  Rambo is a very sweet affectionate lad who loves spending time outside and enjoying the world around him.  He has so much to offer the right family and is looking for a home where he can truly thrive.  Kennel life is incredibly stressful for Rambo.  He struggles with being confined, often scratching and climbing the bars when he becomes overwhelmed.  However, once he is out of his kennel, he relaxes enjoys his surroundings and is a very happy boy with his tail wagging like mad.  Being returned to his kennel is particularly difficult for him, so he would benefit hugely from a home where he can feel safe, settled and secure.  Rambo loves  – long walks getting out and about, off-lead time in our secure compound where he can chase around with his toys, being brushed and enjoying a little pampering and spending time with people receiving lots of fuss and strokes.  Rambo walks nicely on the lead, making him  a lovely companion for someone who enjoys getting outdoors.  As a Husky, he would need an active lifestyle filled with long walks, hikes, adventures and plenty of opportunities to explore.  Rambo is looking for an active, loving home that understands his needs and can offer him time, exercise and the companionship he deserves.  He will need a private secure garden where he can safely enjoy some off lead time as well as an adopter that is committed to keeping him mentally and physically stimulated.  Most importantly, Rambo needs a home where he can feel relaxed and comfortable, away from the stress of kennel life.

Rambo has socialised well with other dogs while in our care, so we feel he could potentially be rehomed with another dog of similar size following a successful meet and greet.

As Rambo came into the home as a stray we have no previous history on him so would prefer any children in the home to be 14+ years.

If you have a holiday in the next 3 months, please wait until you reply to apply for a dog.

name: Wolfie
description:
Wolfie is an ex racer who has spent his life in kennels. He is now in need of a loving comfortable home to call his own. As he has never lived in a home before he will need a family that is willing to put in the training needed to get him comfortable in a new environment. He is a friendly boy who doesn’t mind a fuss but can be a little more independent. He is a chilled boy who enjoys spending time snoozing on his bed. He can get excited when he gets to play with toys.

We think that Wolfie could potentially be rehomed with children who are 12 years and over.

Wolfie could potentially be rehomed with another dog of a similar size and calm temperament – subject to a successful meet.

No cats or small furries for Wolfie due to being an ex racer.

name: Tommy
description:
Tommy is an ex racing greyhound who has spent his life in kennels. He is now looking for a comfortable and loving home to call his own. He will need a family that is happy to introduce and train him around everything that is involved in living in a home environment. Tommy is a very affectionate boy and has been described as a velcro dog by the kennel staff. He is after a home where he can get plenty of attention and cuddles throughout the day. He is a big foodie and is motivated by treats, which is a bonus to help with training.

Tommy is confident around staff and volunteers but due to his size we believe that he would be best suited to an adult only home.

Tommy is a little unsure around most dogs so will need further positive training to help build up his confidence in this area. He is currently paired with another greyhound in the kennel and has has no issues with her, so we believe that he could be rehomed with another calm greyhound or sighthound – subject to a successful meet.

No cats or small furries for Tommy due to his racing background.

name: Amanda
description:
Amanda came into our care as a stray so we don’t have any background information on her. She was a little unsure and nervous when she first arrived but has slowly started to come out of her shell. She can be affectionate once she knows you. She is a typical cheeky Frenchie who likes to have her own way. She is looking for a home with a family that has previous experience or knowledge of the breed and is happy to work with her until she is more settled. We believe that Amanda may need some basic training to help her improve her manners in the home.

Amanda has socialised well with dogs whilst in our care but we feel that she would be best suited to the only dog in the home.

We feel that Amanda would be best suited for an adult only home, no visiting children.

Please do not apply for a dog if you have a holiday within the next 3 months.

name: Rafi
description:
Rafi is a lively, happy boy with a cheeky personality. Rafi is still just a young boy who is in need of a stable and loving home. He is after a family that is happy to put in a lot of time and effort into his training to help him improve his manners. Dobermans are a breed that need to be worked with for their entire life so we are after someone who is fully committed to taking on this responsibility. Experience with this breed or similar is also a must.

Rafi is going to need a large fully enclosed garden that he can have off lead time in, to burn off energy and to help with his training. Rafi will need plenty of walks and mental stimulation to keep him occupied so he doesn’t cause too much mischief. Rafi would benefit from a home where someone is around a lot and has plenty of free time to focus on him and his training.

Rafi is best suited to an adult only home, with no visiting children.

Rafi needs to be the only dog in the home, no visiting dogs either. Rafi is currently under going socialisation training with dogs to help improve his reactivity. This is something that will need to be continued when he goes home and into the future.

Please do not apply for a dog if you have a holiday within the next 3 months.

name: Todd
description:
This handsome boy is Todd!  Todd is a sweet, friendly and very lively boy with plenty of energy to spare!  He is a typical hound in many ways – full of enthusiasm, curious about the world around him and always ready for his next adventure.  He absolutely loves his off-lead time in our secure compound where he can stretch his legs, explore, have a sniff and have fun with his favourite toys.  Watching Todd enjoy himself is a real pleasure! As you would expect from a Fox Hound, Todd is high-energy and needs a very active home that can provide him with plenty of daily exercise.  Walks alone may not be enough to keep his body and mind satisfied, so he would really benefit from additional activities such as scent work, tracking games, enrichment and other opportunities to use his wonderful Hound brain.  Todd is also a vocal boy – hounds are known for their voices, and Todd is certainly not shy about using his!  His new family will need to appreciate that hound singing, baying and general commentary are part of the package.  Hounds are also known for being escape artists so he will need secure, hound-proof fencing and careful management, particularly when he is outdoors. A home that understands the determination and curiosity of a scent-driven hound would be ideal.  Todd has so much character and has all the makings of a fantastic companion in the right home.  He needs someone who understands that a Fox Hound is a lifestyle, not just a pet – but for the right home, Todd will bring plenty of fun, affection and adventure.

Todd has socialised well with other dogs whilst in our care and is very playful and full-on.  We do feel he could potentially live with another dog of similar energy levels that would tolerate his play style following a successful meet and greet.

As Todd came into the home as a stray, we have no previous history on him so would prefer any children in the home to be 16+ years.

name: Shadow
description:
Shadow is a very affectionate boy who has been super friendly to our staff and volunteers since he came in to our care. With him being an ex racer, he does have a high prey drive so can try to chase squirrels whilst out for his walks! He absolutely loves chasing his toys around our secure compound.  He is a really affectionate boy who loves lots of fuss and attention.

Shadow will have spent most of his life in kennels with his racing background, so he may feel a little nervous going in to a home environment. We also do not know if he is house trained or toilet trained due to this. He loves to lie in his comfy beds after his walks – we sometimes catch him upside down showing his belly off!

Shadow has now been in our care for 237 days and is desperately searching for his forever home.

We think Shadow would prefer to be the only dog in the home as he can sometimes be a little unsure around them and isn’t too interested in interacting with them.

He could also potentially live with children 14+ years  – subject to a successful meet.

Shadow would love a home where he could relax and enjoy his retirement years and rest on a comfy bed (or couch) of his own!

name: Prince
description:
Prince came into our care as a stray so we don’t have much history on him. We do believe that he could have potentially lived in a home previously and that he isn’t from a racing background. Prince is a happy excitable boy that jumps up in the kennel when you go into him. He can get very giddy for his walks and loves to be outside taking in all of the different smells. Prince has enjoyed different kinds of enrichment in between his walks and loves playing with his toys. He is a sweet boy who is after a loving forever home.

Prince has been rehomed recently but showed signs of  having separation anxiety so he is in need of a home where someone is around most of the time and is able to build up his time being left. Experience with sight hounds or rescue dogs will be beneficial to ensure that he is getting the training that he needs to settle into a new home.

Prince would be best suited to a home with children who are 16 years and over due to his bouncy nature – subject to a successful meet.

Prince initially could be vocal around dogs due to being a little unsure, we have now found out this is due to him wanting to say hello. He has been on group walks recently and loved interacting with other dogs and saying hello. He can be very enthusiastic when meeting dogs so we need someone that is able to physically hold onto him so he can continue on with his socialisation  training and learn better manners around dogs. We still think it would be best for him to be the only dog in the home so he can be the main focus.

Please do not apply for a dog if you have a holiday within the next 3 months.

name: Cindy
description:
We don’t have any previous history on Cindy due to her coming into our care as a stray. Although we soon learnt that she is super sweet and absolutely loves all the attention. Cindy has been very affectionate with everyone and loves meeting new people. She does have a cheeky and giddy side as well, that likes to come out, meaning she does enjoy playing and running around.

Cindy’s family must be willing and aware that she will need grooming every so often to keep her fur maintained. Cindy will need some on going treatments when she goes home so please consider this before applying.

Since being in our care, she has enjoyed being in the company of other dogs and gets all excited and wants to play. We do believe she could potentially live with another dog of a similar temperament – subject to a successful meet.

We do believe she could potentially live with children 10 years old, this would be subject to a successful meet.

It is unknown how Cindy would be living with cats or other small animals.

name: Simea
description:
She was born on site, along with her siblings who have now been rehomed, when her Mum sadly came into our care pregnant as a stray.

We are looking for experienced adult only home, who have owned Malinois or Shepherds before. She isn’t going to be a dog that is interested in working but she is still going to need a very active home with someone who is looking to train her to work in sports or something similar.

New owners must be willing to take to puppy classes and continue socialising, as this is vital for this particular breed. She will need constant mental as well as physical stimulation, her new family must be willing to provide this.

She may potentially live with another dog, it will need to be a neutered male of a similar temperament and willing to put up with a young pup – subject to a successful meet.

Please do not apply for a dog if you have a holiday within the next 3 months.

name: Hero
description:
Hero is an ex racing greyhound who is now looking for his forever home with a family that can help him settle into life beyond the kennels. He is a confident, lively boy with plenty of personality. He gets very excited when it’s time for a walk and can jump around on the lead, so will need someone who is comfortable handling a tall strong greyhound. With a little training and consistency this is something that can be worked on. Although he is confident in many ways, he does need help building his confidence when it comes to being touched and handled as he can get a little worried.  Hero deserves the chance to learn, grow and discover just how good life can be outside of kennels.

Hero can be rehomed with mature children who are 16 years and over, due to his size and bouncy nature. This will be subject to a successful meet.

Hero is currently paired with another greyhound and has interreacted well with dogs whilst in our care, so we believe that he would be rehomed with another dog- subject to a successful meet and greet.

name: Ripley
description:
Meet Ripley!! He is a gorgeous boy looking for an active, committed home where he can continue to learn and thrive.  He’s a friendly, affectionate boy with a fun-loving personality and is always ready for a game with his favourite toys.  He is full of energy and loves to play, so he will need an active family who can provide plenty of exercise, enrichment, and ongoing training.  Like many young dogs, he can become a little mouthy and nippy when he’s excited, so he will benefit from patient guidance and positive reinforcement to help him learn appropriate manners.  He is still working on his basic commands and will need someone willing to continue his training.  He can also occasionally rag his lead, so further lead training will be important.  Previous experience with Shar-pei’s would be a real advantage, as they can have their own unique characteristics and training needs.   If you’re looking for a playful, lively young dog and have to time and commitment to help him become the wonderful companion we know he can be, Ripley could be the boy for you.

Ripley has socialised well with other dogs and is very playful with them.  He can sometimes get frustrated and bark if he can’t get to them straight away.  We do feel he would be best rehomed as the only dog where he can continue to learn appropriate ways to interact with other dogs.

As Ripley came into the home as a stray we have no previous history on him and as he can be a little nippy when over-excited we would like any children in the home to be 16+ years.

name: Nibbles
description:
Nibbles is a young boy who is full of energy and mischief! Nibbles loves being off lead in our enclosed area running around chasing tennis balls. He has a lot of energy so will need a very active home with a family who can take him out on lots of adventures to burn off his energy. He would benefit from mental stimulation in between walks to keep his brain stimulated. Due to being a young dog Nibbles will need a lot of further training to help him grow up to be a well mannered boy.

He can be a little nippy at times due to over excitement so he needs a family that is willing to put up with this whilst he is learning to calm down in a home environment. Nibbles has found leaving kennels and going into home life to be challenging and has therefore been returned twice. Please consider all of the challenges that come with taking on a young dog that has been in kennels for most of his life before applying. With a lot of work Nibbles will be a great companion but it will take a lot of hard work and patience to get there, he is not going to be an easy dog.

Nibbles came into our care as a stray so we don’t have any history on him. Due to being very  friendly we think that he can be rehomed with dog savvy children who are 16 years and older – subject to a successful meet.

Nibbles is friendly with every dog he meets and always wants to play but doesn’t have any manners so can be very over the top. He can potentially be rehomed with another dog that can tolerate his high energy and playfulness – subject to a successful meet.

Please do not apply for a dog if you have a holiday within the next 3 months.

name: Elias
description:
Elias is a very sweet and friendly boy. He came into our care as a stray so we don’t have any background information on him. He has always been friendly with staff and volunteers whilst here. Elias can be a little strong on the lead due to his size so some basic lead training would be beneficial for him. We are looking for an active home for Elias as he has a lot of energy and would enjoy going on lots of adventures. Elias is a calm boy in his kennel and loves to have some down time with a tasty chew.

Elias is a friendly boy but due to his size we believe that it would be best for him to be rehomed with children over 14 years and over – Subject to a successful meet.

Elias needs a little more training around dogs since his castration as he has become a little unsure, therefore we believe that Elias would benefit from being the only dog in the home as he would prefer all the attention on him.

name: Ronnie
description:
Ronnie is a cheeky girl who is looking for a caring forever home. She is a bouncy girl that is full of energy and would love to go out for lots of adventures. She constantly wants to be out on walks and tries her hardest to escape from the kennel when the door is open- she’s a cheeky monkey! She is super friendly with everyone she meets and enjoys shouting at you if you try to ignore her- she constantly wants attention. Ronnie has shown signs of separation anxiety so is looking for an experienced home that has dealt with this previously. Ronnie is a typical Frenchie so she is in need of a home that has owned Frenchie’s previously.

She is a friendly girl but can get a little jealous when the attention isn’t on her, so we believe it would be best for her to be in an adult only home with no visiting children. Ronnie would be best suited to a quiet home with not many visitors.

Ronnie has socialised well with other dogs whilst in our care, however, we believe she would be best suited to a home where she can be the only dog, so she can have all the attention and love. She may need on going socialisation training around dogs due to her being in the kennels for so long.

name: Sam
description:
Sam is a very loveable boy who just wants to give out hugs to everyone he meets, he does sometimes forget how big he is though. He’s a big hit with volunteers here and they all love taking him out for his walks as they get to have lots of cuddles. He can be strong on the lead though due to his size. He’s a very sweet boy who has a big heart and is looking for someone to show him lots of love! Sam has enjoyed his walks around the woods, watching the ducks and wildlife around him. Sam would appreciate an enclosed garden that he can spend his time in relaxing and enjoying the sun. Sam loves his treats, nothing is too big or small for him – he isn’t fussy!

Sam is super friendly with everyone he meets but due to his giddy jumpy nature we believe that it would be best to rehome Sam with children over the age of 16 – subject to a successful meet and greet.

Sam needs to be the only dog in the home, he can be vocal around dogs so needs a family that has experience to help build his confidence and manners.

If you think that you could provide a comfortable home with lots of treats for Sam please apply now!

name: Florence
description:
Florence is super friendly and loves everyone that she meets! She likes to leave her mark on you in the form of drool! She absolutely loves her food and isn’t fussy at all – she will eat anything. She has recently been on a diet and her new home must be willing to continue this to help her reach her ideal weight. When you go to see her in the kennel, she is so wriggly and happy and just wants love and affection all the time. She will jump up at you to give kisses and doesn’t realise what a big chunk she is! Florence needs a home that can provide her with short walks throughout the day to help with her weight loss. Florence needs a fully enclosed private garden that she can use in between her walks, she wouldn’t be suitable to live in a flat.

Florence is looking for a adult only home. She would prefer a home where someone is around for most of the day so she can have lots of cuddles.

Florence can be a little unsure around other dogs. We have been working on socialisation with her to get her used to other dogs but this is something her new family will need to keep up so she can build her confidence. Due to this, she would be most comfortable being the only dog in the home.

name: Valentin
description:
Meet Valentin, a 1.5 year old male Hound Cross weighing 25 kilograms. He’s a beautiful young hound who has already been through so much in his short life.

Valentin came from a pound in northern Spain, where he was sadly stuck for six months before being rescued. Like many hounds in the region, he was likely a discarded hunting dog, but despite his past, he has kept his gentle spirit.

This lovely boy is in excellent health – he has been fully blood tested (including brucellosis), neutered, microchipped, and has his passport ready for travel.

Valentin gets along wonderfully with other dogs and would thrive in a home with canine companions. He can be a little timid when first meeting new people, but he warms up with patience and kindness and is incredibly loyal once he trusts you.

Valentin is ready to start the next chapter of his life – and he can travel! He is ready to travel, making it easier than ever to welcome him into your family.

As with all of our dogs, he comes with full rescue back-up for life.

name: Chiara
description:
Chiara is a 2.5 year old female Cross-Breed currently under the care of Network for Animals – Azil Danica in Bosnia. She was heartbreakingly dumped as a puppy outside the shelter with her siblings back in November 2023.

Sadly, due to a lack of promotion, she never got the chance to be adopted — but now it’s her time to shine and finally find her forever home.

Chiara weighs around 15 kilograms, making her a perfectly medium-sized girl. She’s friendly, eager to please, and walks well on the lead.

She currently shares her kennel space with three other dogs and gets along wonderfully with them. She also ignores cats, making her a great fit for multi-pet homes.

Chiara is vaccinated, blood tested, flea and worm treated, microchipped, and spayed. She’s a happy, loving girl who’s ready to start her next chapter — one filled with warmth, care, and the family she’s always deserved.

Rescue support and backup by Meadow of Hope Dog Rescue.

name: Pirelli
description:
Pirelli is a 2 year old male medium Lurcher.

Pirelli came into our care as a stray and was never claimed by an owner. We believe he may have been used for working as he has a high prey drive and loves playing with squeaky toys.

He is one of our longest dogs on site and although he has walked with a couple of other sighthounds, he would love to be the only animal in his new home.

He does enjoy company of older children but can jump quite high and is very leggy so would best suit a home with teenagers.

A lover of all people and very inquisitive, Pirelli is fantastic at meeting and greeting and loves to run around off lead in a secure field. He is muzzled and kept on lead when out on walks due to his prey drive.

name: Splash
description:
Splash came into our care as a stray and was never claimed by an owner. He has struggled with kennel life and just wants a human to love.

Possibly from a working background, Splash’s prey drive is very high, and he is kept on lead and muzzled when walked but loves sprinting around in a secure field.

Splash does find a lot of things overwhelming and is looking for a calm and relaxed approach to life but with lots of fun and delicious treats at home.

Splash is very smart and does get quite excited when meeting new people. He is best suited with living teenagers and as the only animal.

He has however been walked with other sighthounds but does get over the top.

name: Sailor
description:
SAILOR — READY TO BECOME SOMEONE’S WHOLE WORLD

Sailor is a three-year-old Lagotto mix male.

Sailor has the kind of face that stays with you.

That handsome Lagotto look that makes you stop for a moment longer every time you see him.

But Sailor is more than just a beautiful dog.

He is a wonderful three-year-old boy, full of life, love and possibility, ready to become part of someone’s world.

Beautiful, proud and incredibly handsome, with a softness about him that makes you want to reach and touch those soft curls.

Sailor is good with other dogs and enjoys canine company. He could happily share his life with a compatible dog, or finally have all the love of a family to himself.

Young enough to have years of adventures ahead of him.

Ready for long walks, new places, familiar voices and the comfort of knowing exactly where he belongs.

Sailor deserves to be more than a beautiful face people pause to admire.

He deserves to have someone learn every expression in those eyes.

To become the dog whose presence is deeply woven into a home that life without him becomes impossible to imagine.

There is an entire lifetime inside this boy.

Years of love waiting to become part of someone’s story.

Ready for someone to look at him and see their boy.

3 years oldHandsome Lagotto mixGood with other dogsLoving, beautiful and ready for family lifeStrong, striking and full of possibilityLooking for a cat-free home

Fully vaccinatedNeutered4D testedBrucellosis tested

name: Maddie
description:
MADDIE — EVERYTHING A FAMILY COULD HOPE FOR!

The hardest thing about Maddie is knowing that a dog this beautiful inside is still waiting for someone to see her.

And she already carries the kind of nature that people spend years hoping to find in a dog.

Maddie is gentle in a way that reaches straight into your heart.

She is quiet, affectionate and soft in everything she does. She is simply a kind girl who makes being beside her feel peaceful.

And she is incredibly gentle and friendly with children.

Maddie has so much to offer a family, yet she asks for nothing more than the chance to belong to one.

A whole lifetime of loyalty, affection and companionship waiting to be given.

And somewhere, there must be a person or family whose life is missing exactly what Maddie carries.

1-year-old femaleSmall-to-medium-sized Lab mixWonderful with other dogsCat friendlyVery child-friendlyGentle, calm, affectionate and incredibly kindLead trained

Fully vaccinatedSpayed4D testedBrucellosis tested

Please do not let this beautiful girl grow up without ever knowing what it feels like to be someone’s whole world.

name: Remi
description:
REMI — THE KIND OF DOG WHO MAKES A HOUSE FEEL LIKE HOME

Remi is the kind of dog whose gentleness reaches you before anything else.

Before you notice how breathtakingly beautiful he is.

Before you notice his elegant Pointer features or his gorgeous silky coat.

The quiet warmth he carries wherever he goes.

Remi is three years old, and he is truly everything a family could hope for in a dog.

He is affectionate, beautifully mannered and wonderfully easy-going. He gets along perfectly with other dogs and has such a peaceful, balanced nature.

A softness that makes being around him feel easy.

He does not need to be loud to fill a space.

Remi is the kind of companion who would bring calm into a home, tenderness into ordinary days and the steady love only a truly good dog can give.

He is beautiful to look at, but it is his nature that stays with you.

Ready to become the dog someone will look at every day and wonder how they were ever lucky enough to find him.

Because Remi is not simply a perfect dog on paper.

He is the kind of dog who could make a home feel warmer just by being part of it.

3 years oldMedium-large, full-breed English PointerGets along beautifully with dogsCalm, gentle, affectionate and quietly joyfulWell-mannered, easy-going and a peaceful companion

Fully vaccinatedNeutered4D testedBrucellosis tested

name: Orchid
description:
ORCHID – THE KIND OF LOVE THAT CHANGES A HOME!

Orchid is a one-year-old female cross breed.

She saw us… and she chose us. Inside a kill shelter, surrounded by fear, noise, and dogs slowly giving up, Orchid stepped forward with everything she had — hope, trust, and a quiet plea to be taken out of that life.

We took her. And she never looked back. From that day on, she has lived every moment as if it matters — with joy, with softness, and a kind of gratitude you can feel just by being near her.

Orchid is a gorgeous, middle-to-small sized girl, around a year old, and she carries something incredibly rare — a heart that stays open, no matter what she has been through. She is also absolutely beautiful.

Orchid is happiness you can touch. With dogs, she blends in effortlessly — playful, social, kind. With people, she becomes soft and affectionate, always close, always connected.

With children, she is pure gentleness — patient, careful, and full of love. She brings light into a space without trying. She settles into your life as if she has always been part of it.

There is no heaviness in her. Only warmth, softness, and that quiet joy that stays. Orchid is the kind of companion who doesn’t just live beside you — she becomes part of your everyday rhythm, your calm, your happiness.

A small dog with a huge heart. A soul that chose life… and never stopped being grateful for it.

ORCHID AT A GLANCE:Around 1 year oldMiddle-small sized mixed breedGets along beautifully with all dogs & cat-friendlyGentle, cuddly, joyful, full of warmthEasy-going, people-oriented, naturally well-behaved

HEALTH:Fully VaccinatedNeutering to be arranged4D TestedBrucellosis TestedMicrochippedFull RBU

If you are ready for a dog who will fill your home with warmth, closeness, and gentle joy — Orchid is waiting for you.

name: Audrey
description:
Audrey is a one-year-old female Labrador x Pointer Mix.

There was a moment in her life when the world showed her its harshest side. Left by the road with her siblings, Audrey was only a tiny puppy, surviving on scraps and learning far too early what it feels like to be unwanted.

She grew into a beautiful, gentle girl with a quiet kind of presence. The kind of beauty that does not ask to be noticed. The kind that reveals itself slowly, like a flower opening when it finally feels the warmth of the sun.

Audrey carries a softness that cannot be taught. A gentleness that survived everything life placed in front of her.

When she first meets you, she may watch from a small distance.

Her eyes will follow you carefully, trying to understand who you are and whether she can let herself feel safe.

And then, little by little, she begins to come closer.

A small step. A gentle wag of her tail. A softness in her eyes that was not there before. And suddenly, you realise she is beginning to trust you. With Audrey, trust is never something ordinary.

AUDREY AT A GLANCE:1 year oldMedium-sized Lab mix × English PointerGets along beautifully with other dogsGentle, calm and lovingA little shy at first, but incredibly soft once she feels safe

HEALTH:Fully vaccinatedSpayed4D testedBrucellosis testedMicrochippedFull RBU

Audrey is not the loudest girl in the room. She will not push herself forward or demand to be chosen.But the love she carries is deep, loyal and incredibly pure.

She needs someone who understands that the most beautiful bonds are sometimes the ones that are given time. Someone patient.

Someone kind. Someone who will let her discover, at her own pace, that she is finally home.

And when Audrey truly feels safe, we know she will give everything she has been quietly holding inside.

Her trust. Her loyalty. Her whole heart. She is a quiet soul. A gentle girl. A beautiful life waiting for the person who will help her bloom.

If something in Audrey touches your heart, please send us a message.

She is waiting for someone who will see past that first shy moment and recognise the love already waiting underneath. We would love to hear from you.

name: Ebony
description:
Ebony is a 1-year-old female Cross-Breed. She’s a small dog weighing around 12 kilograms, with a soft, sweet expression that perfectly matches her gentle personality.

Her name might sound dark and mysterious, but underneath, she’s a sensitive soul with a big heart just waiting to shine.

At first, Ebony can be a little shy, especially in new surroundings or with unfamiliar people. However, once she realises she’s safe, her friendly and affectionate side begins to bloom.

She’s the kind of dog who will quietly observe before stepping forward for cuddles, making every bit of trust she gives feel like a real gift.

Ebony gets along well with other dogs and would thrive in a calm, understanding home where she can build confidence at her own pace.

A patient adopter will see her blossom day by day, gaining courage and showing more of her naturally kind, loyal nature.

She would especially benefit from living with a small or medium-sized resident dog who can help guide her and show her the ropes of home life.

Having a confident canine companion could help Ebony settle in faster and learn how to relax in her new environment.

Ebony is fully vaccinated and blood tested, with full rescue backup and support provided by Pennypaws Rescue. A home check via video will be required before adoption to ensure her new home is the right match.

Sweet and gentle Ebony would make a wonderful companion, and she’d make a great duo with her friend Noir. Together or on her own, she’s sure to bring warmth, quiet joy, and lasting love to the lucky family who welcomes her.

name: Kyro
description:
Welcome the very definition of joy in dog form — Kyro! Kyro is a four year old male Staffordshire Bull Terrier Cross, medium in size, with a huge grin, a happy-go-lucky personality, and endless enthusiasm for life. He’s truly impossible not to love.

Kyro is a fun-loving, affectionate lad who absolutely adores people. He’s happiest when he’s part of the action — whether that’s playtime in the garden, exploring new places on walks, or curling up nearby for a well-earned snooze afterwards.

He thrives on human companionship and has a wonderful, cheeky charm that makes everyone who meets him smile.

He’s also a clever boy who loves to learn. Kyro responds brilliantly to positive reinforcement and enjoys training sessions that keep his brain busy. He’s eager to please and loves to show off his progress — especially if there are treats or cuddles involved!

Kyro can be a little reactive towards other dogs, but we’re already helping him with this. With patient, careful introductions and ongoing guidance, he’s making fantastic progress.

He’s learning that not all dogs are something to worry about, and with continued support in his new home, he’ll only keep improving.

Kyro is fully vaccinated, microchipped, and awaiting castration, so he’s almost ready to start his next chapter with a loving forever family.

He’s currently in kennels, where he’s adored by everyone who meets him — but despite all the love and attention, Kyro does find kennel life a little stressful.

He would much prefer the comfort and calm of a home environment, where he can properly relax and show just how wonderful he really is.

Kyro is looking for a pet-free, adult-only home where he can be the centre of attention. He loves people, but he’ll thrive best in a calm, consistent environment without other pets or children.

If you’re looking for a companion who’ll make you laugh every single day and fill your home with warmth, Kyro might just be your perfect match.

name: Aria
description:
Meet Aria, a two year old female Staffordshire Bull Terrier Cross who’s medium to large in size.

Aria is a big-hearted girl with a lot of love to give, but she’s currently very overweight and needs someone experienced with large breed dogs who can provide her with structure, patience, and consistent boundaries.

Aria is a large, very overweight dog who needs someone experienced with large breed dogs and can teach her clear boundaries. They need to be confident in their training abilities or be prepared to seek out help from a trainer.

She needs regular exercise in a safe environment such as a dog field until she has built up her confidence around other dogs again. She will need to be on a strict diet to get her down to a sensible weight.

It is felt that Aria has become both traumatised and overprotective in her current home. She will need someone who is around most of the time but will build up some alone time for her too.

She has previously used a crate and may feel more secure using one again. She will need to be trained to use a muzzle and walk on a lead or long line at all times.

As Aria has been unpredictable with men lately, it is felt that she would be more suited to a female-only home. She needs to be treated like a dog and not a baby, have clear boundaries, and someone who can stick to them.

She is a dog with a lot of love to give but needs to be given time and patience to settle into her new home and understand her boundaries.

Aria travels well in the car and likes looking out of the window. Aria is a young girl who just needs someone with experience that understands her past is unknown but can work on her future together.

name: Skye
description:
