Meet Skye, a two year old extra large male Cane Corso Cross. He’s a big, bouncy boy full of energy and affection, with that classic Cane Corso enthusiasm that can fill a room.

Skye is strong on the lead and tends to pull when out walking, but he’s doing well with muzzle training and is extremely food-motivated — a huge bonus for anyone who enjoys training with treats!

Skye hasn’t shown any signs of aggression toward his trusted volunteer in kennels, though he does like to bark at people and dogs — typical Cane Corso behavior.

He’s a loving dog who thrives on affection and attention. Skye would do best in a calm home without other pets or children, where he can get consistent training and structure.

He’ll need a dedicated owner who understands his background and is willing to help him move forward with patience and guidance. Skye must be walked on a muzzle, 5-point harness, and lead at all times — never off lead — to keep him safe.

He generally walks well but can get excited and grab the lead; with ongoing training, he’s learning to stop when told.

Skye will need someone around most of the time, with alone time introduced gradually once he’s settled. His new home should have a secure property and garden to prevent escape.

While he was house-trained in his previous home, he may need a quick refresher after his time in kennels.

Skye has missed out on a lot of love, but with trust and time, he’ll give back tenfold and become a loyal, affectionate companion.

name: Marlowe
description:
Marlowe is a 8-year-old male Husky Cross. He is currently in foster care in Lincolnshire and is looking for his forever home.

This sweet boy does have some health challenges, as he is already blind in one eye and sadly losing sight in the other. Despite this, Marlowe doesn’t let it get him down and remains a loving, affectionate companion.

Marlowe is well known for his cuddly nature, earning himself the title of a cuddle monster. He absolutely thrives on human company and enjoys being close to people.

He has so much affection to give, and his future family will quickly see just how loyal and gentle he can be.

Marlowe is described as extremely well behaved, making him a joy to have around the home. He gets on well with other dogs, showing that he is sociable and adaptable.

He has already been neutered and microchipped, which means some of the important essentials are already taken care of.

This lovely Husky Cross comes with lifetime rescue backup (RBU), showing the commitment of those who care about him to ensure he is supported throughout his life.

His only wish is to find someone who can accept his vision loss and love him for the wonderful dog he truly is. Please consider Marlowe—he has so much love still to share.

name: Darcy
description:
Darcy is a 2 year old female Cross-Breed. She’s a beautiful, friendly girl with a sweet nature and a big heart. Rescued from a terrible kill shelter, she’s now ready for a second chance at life and dreaming of a loving home in the UK.

It’s hard not to fall for her hopeful eyes and wagging tail that seem to say she knows her best days are yet to come.

Darcy’s love for people shines through in everything she does. She adores human attention, greeting everyone with warmth and trust despite her past. Her temperament is well-balanced — gentle, affectionate, and eager to please.

With her cheerful attitude, she’s bound to bring light and happiness to any home that welcomes her.

At the shelter, Darcy has shown herself to be a good girl with other dogs, interacting politely and confidently. She can be cat tested if needed, showing just how adaptable and eager she is to fit into different family environments.

Because she hasn’t had experience with very young children, a home with kids aged eight and over would be most suitable, giving her space to feel comfortable while still enjoying family life.

Weighing around 17 kilograms, Darcy is a medium-sized dog who’s already neutered, fully vaccinated, and has completed her full blood tests. She’s all set to travel with her passport and join her forever family directly — no delays, just love and new beginnings.

Darcy is ready to leave the shelter behind and step into a home where she’ll be cherished for the wonderful dog she truly is. Her rescue story may have started in hardship, but her future promises to be bright, filled with warmth, affection, and security.

name: Laura
description:
Our extra special girl Laura is approximately three years old and the most stunning medium sized cross breed. Laura weighs just twelve kilos and measures twelve inches from shoulder to paw.

Having been found abandoned on the streets, Laura has been in our Cyprus shelter for one month.

Laura can be best described as incredibly close to canine perfection.

Her smile is perpetual, her eyes are bright and engaging, her ears are prize winning, her teeth are shining white, and her glorious tri-colour coat is enhanced by an array of freckles and a pigmented tummy.

She adores her play time with her friends and engages beautifully with her bubbly sweet personality. If ever there was a prime adoption candidate designed to make a family unbelievably happy it’s Laura.

She walks nicely on her lead and enjoys her time in the car. Laura seems to mix perfectly well with other dogs, cats and children.

name: Hannah
description:
Our extra special girl Hannah is approximately three years old and a cross breed at the very bottom end of medium with a strong beagle appearance.

Hannah weighs a perfect eleven kilos and measures thirteen inches from shoulder to paw. Having been found abandoned on the streets, Hannah has been in our Cyprus shelter for three weeks.

Having clearly been preloved, Hannah is finding shelter life not to her liking. She is longing for her forever home away from the noise and bustle.

Hannah leans towards being timid but will thrive and blossom with her very fortunate adopting family. She yearns for peace and routine and will repay love and kindness with huge premiums.

Hannah’s appearance is exceptional in every aspect. Her tricolour coat is just glorious with some freckles and the loveliest ears ending in a point. Her kind, empathetic and loving nature abounds. Hannah is a truly wonderful adoption candidate.

She enjoys her time in the car and walks nicely on her lead. Hannah seems to mix perfectly well with other dogs, cats and children.

name: Tamsin
description:
Our extra special girl Tamsin is approximately two years old and the most beautiful mixed breed with something of a hound appearance.

Tamsin weighs a delightful thirteen kilos and measures fifteen inches from shoulder to paw. Having been found abandoned on the streets, Tamsin has been in our Cyprus shelter for three months.

Our shelter manager reports that Tamsin has the sweetest and calm personality, and she thoroughly enjoys walking on the lead where her behaviour is exemplary.

Tamsin has a wonderful personality and exudes kindness and empathy. She thoroughly enjoys her time with her human companions and shares happiness and affection.

Tamsin is absolutely beautiful with her rich tan and black coat, puppy dog eyes, striking ears and a near perpetual smile. Film star quality looks to say the very least. Tamsin is the ideal adoption candidate who is ready made for a kind and loving family.

Tamsin enjoys her time in the car and seems to mix perfectly well with other dogs, cats, kittens, children and donkeys.

name: Serena
description:
*** SERENA WILL COME TO FOSTER IN BANSTEAD, SURREY, ON 1ST NOVEMBER 2026 ***

Our extra special girl Serena is approximately two years old and a medium sized cross breed perhaps with something of a hound content.

Serena weighs thirteen kilos and measures ten inches from shoulder to paw. Having been found abandoned on the streets, Serena has been in our Cyprus shelter for around four months.

Our shelter manager describes Serena as very sweet and she has an exceptionally loving personality. Serena enjoys amazing eye contact with her favourite human and constantly wins numerous hearts.

Her sandy coat is beautifully enhanced with a white flash to her chest along with four white toe tips. Her ears are gorgeous and probably award winning, leaving Serena as visually stunning.

Serena is the ideal adoption candidate and will make a perfect addition to her forever family. She is so deserving.

Serena enjoys her time in the car and walks nicely on her lead. She also seems to mix perfectly well with other dogs, cats and children.

name: Lily
description:
Our extra special girl Lily is approximately six years old and a near perfect cross breed at the bottom end of medium sized. Lily weighs just fourteen kilos and measures fourteen inches from shoulder to paw.

Having been found on the streets Lily has been in our Cyprus shelter for one month.

Our shelter manager reports that Lily is very timid and needs lots of reassurance. She is quiet, very sweet and walks beautifully on her lead. Which begs the question: what more does a girl have to do?

Lily is so attractive with her shining black coat and delicate features. Her gorgeous eyes are perfectly enhanced with her prize-winning ears and sublime expressions.

A very discerning adopting family will recognise the prize that Lily represents. She will be so grateful to join a quiet family in an orderly house with a steady routine. Paradise for all concerned.

Lily seems to mix perfectly well with other dogs, cats and children.

name: Lasi
description:
Our extra special girl Lasi is approximately two years old and a very splendid cross breed at the bottom end of medium. Lasi weighs just fourteen kilos and measures twelve inches from shoulder to paw.

Having been found abandoned on the streets, Lasi has been in our Cyprus shelter for four months.

Lasi has been described by our shelter manager as calm, sweet, eager to please and will make a fabulous family dog.

Her appearance is breathtaking with a light tan coat and a graduated darker tan along her back. Gorgeous hazel eyes and beautiful ears are showstoppers.

Lasi will fit into her forever home so well and will bring years of joy and happiness to her very fortunate adopters.

Lasi walks nicely on her lead and enjoys her time in the car. She seems to mix perfectly well with children, cats and other dogs.

name: Fenton
description:
Fenton, is we believe, between eighteen months and two years old and a wire-haired pointer or thereabouts.

Fenton has been in our Cyprus Shelter for just a couple of months, having been found abandoned on the streets.

Fenton sounds like he would make a wonderful addition to any family!

His relaxed demeanour and easy-going nature make him an excellent candidate for adoption.

His ability to get along well with other animals and children also makes him very adaptable to different household environments.

He is strikingly good-looking and a handsome boy with his black, grey and brindle coat.

It is great to hear that Fenton walks nicely on a lead as this suggests he is open to training and willing to please.

As Fenton is still relatively young, he is likely has plenty of energy for walks and playtime, but he will also appreciate some quiet time for relaxation.

Overall, it sounds like Fenton has a lot to offer to a lucky family or individual.

With his friendly disposition and adaptability, he is sure to bring joy and companionship wherever he goes.

Please open your heart and give Fenton his forever home where he can be loved and cherished.

name: Cade
description:
Cade is a 1 year old male Sharpei Cross. His current weight is 29kg.

Cade is looking for a new home where he’ll be very much involved in what’s going on.

Cade is very enthusiastic when meeting new people and can be overwhelming for some.

A family experienced in handling dogs is preferred.

Cade is very sociable around other dogs and can live with a dog-savvy cat.

Due to his “bull in a china shop” manner, a home with no children is preferred, although Cade can live with teenagers.

He is crate trained and sees the crate as his time to chill.

Cade isn’t used to being left alone and has always had the company of other dogs, so this will need to be gradually built up in his new home.

Cade is very food-driven, which benefits his training.

All applicants must live within 1 hours drive from Upminster Essex.

name: Peck
description:
Peck is a 3-4-month-old male cross breed, discovered alongside his brother Greg, abandoned near the shelter in Lousã, central Portugal.

These poor pups were rescued, underweight and frightened, and have since received nourishment and tender care, transforming into healthy and vibrant little companions eager to find their forever homes.

While the exact breed remains uncertain, there’s a suggestion of Portuguese Podengo in Peck and Greg, anticipating a small to medium size when fully grown.

Despite their challenging start in life, Peck, though initially timid, readily places trust in humans and exhibits confidence around other dogs.

He currently shares a kennel with three other puppies, demonstrating his sociable nature. Peck has shown positive responsiveness to harness training, allowing for easy lead walks.

He holds great potential to become a delightful companion, provided with the dedication and training that a young pup requires.

As part of the adoption process, Peck has been chipped, vaccinated, and health-tested, ensuring his readiness for a new home.

The adoption fee of £450 covers not only Peck’s well-being but also includes transport to the UK through a reputable company, comprehensive foster support, and the necessary vaccinations for the journey.

name: Greg
description:
Greg is a 3-4-month-old male cross breed currently residing in Lousã, central Portugal. Found abandoned along with his brother Peck near a shelter, these two pups were in dire straits – alone, scared, and emaciated.

Thanks to the care they received, both Peck and Greg have made remarkable recoveries and are now healthy little pups eagerly awaiting their forever homes.

While the exact breed of these pups remains uncertain, there’s a hint of Portuguese Podengo in their lineage, and they are expected to be small to medium-sized when fully grown.

Greg, in particular, showcases a timid demeanor owing to early mistreatment, but he readily places his trust in humans. His confidence shines through when interacting with other dogs, as he shares a kennel with three other puppies.

Recently introduced to harnesses and leads, Greg is already adapting well and is poised to become an ideal companion for someone willing to invest time and effort into a puppy’s training.

As part of the adoption process, Greg has undergone essential procedures like microchipping, vaccination, and health testing.

The adoption fee for Greg is £450, covering not only these medical necessities but also the cost of transportation to the UK facilitated by a reputable company. Adopters can be assured of full foster backup, ensuring a smooth transition for Greg into his new home.

name: Milo
description:
Milo is an 8-year-old male Mioritic shepherd cross, measuring 56cm in height, residing in Romania.

Rescued from a public shelter, Milo’s heart longs for a loving home where he can spend his remaining years.

Despite his size, he possesses a gentle heart and hopes to find someone special to share his life with.

Currently staying in a private shelter, Milo awaits the day someone chooses him to be part of their family.

He seeks an experienced home capable of caring for big dogs like him, preferably with knowledge of Mioritic breeds.

Transitioning to a new environment, Milo will need time to decompress and adjust, making patience and kindness essential qualities in his future owners.

A secure garden would be ideal for him to play and explore safely, fulfilling his desire for outdoor activities.

On the medical front, Milo is fully vaccinated, blood tested, and has received flea and worm treatments.

He is also neutered, microchipped, and registered in the Recs system.

Milo is prepared for travel to the U.K. with his own passport and import papers, though he understands the journey will take time.

name: Beau
description:
Beau is a 3.5-year-old male cross-breed. He is a wonderful and calm dog, longing for a home where he can feel loved and secure.

Rescued from a public shelter in Romania, Beau currently resides in a private shelter, where he has shown himself to be a calm and gentle character.

Weighing 18kg, Beau is vaccinated, blood tested, flead, wormed, neutered, and microchipped. His thick coat and beautiful black button nose add to his charm.

Despite his past, Beau interacts well with everyone in the shelter and lives peacefully with two males and a female dog in his kennel.

Beau has met older children, specifically teenagers, and has shown a calm and gentle demeanour around them. He has no allergies or intolerances and does not require any regular medications.

An ideal home for Beau would be one with dog-experienced owners who can provide a secure garden for him to explore. The household should be calm, kind, and patient, with older children aged 14 and above.

Although Beau is calm and gentle, he needs support with lead training, house training, and continued socialising. It is important to note that Beau is not suitable to live with cats.

Beau’s potential new family will need to go through the application and checks process with Meadow Of Hope Dog Rescue UK.

This ensures that Beau will be placed in a suitable environment where he can thrive and be happy.

name: Kalea
description:
Kalea, a lovely and calm girl, is rescued from a distressing public shelter in Romania.

Approximately 6 years old, Kalea has been thriving in a private foster home for over a year, enjoying the care and attention she deserves.

Walking nicely on a lead, Kalea has adapted well to both female and male caregivers. In good health, she boasts no known allergies or intolerances. She is spayed, vaccinated, blood-tested, flea, and worm-treated, and microchipped, ensuring she is ready for her forever home.

In her quest for the perfect home, Kalea is looking for a calm and friendly environment, ideally with individuals who are rescue dog-savvy. She could happily coexist with another dog, and older children aged 14 and above, provided they are dog-savvy as well.

A secure garden is on her wishlist, creating a safe space for her to enjoy.

Kalea thrives in a home that isn’t too bustling with constant comings and goings, seeking a haven that provides love, compassion, and safety. Her potential adopters are urged to be prepared to go above and beyond to meet the needs of a rescue dog.

Recognizing the considerable journey these dogs undertake to find a home, it’s crucial to afford them the time they need to decompress, which may extend to days or even weeks.

The adoption process for Kalea involves an application and checks, ensuring that her potential adopters are committed to providing the care, understanding, and patience required for a dog with a challenging past.

For those ready to open their hearts and homes to Kalea, the reward will be the companionship and gratitude of a soul on its journey to a brighter future.

name: Twix
description:
Twix is a small, approximately 1-2-year-old female Cross-Breed currently in Romania, seeking a loving family.

Vaccinated and spayed, Twix is microchipped and ready for adoption.

She was abandoned and found roaming the streets, highlighting her need for a stable and caring home where she will be cherished forever.

Twix is described as friendly and gets along well with both people and other dogs, making her a good fit for a family environment.

She is suitable for children aged 8 and above, indicating she can adapt well to a household with older kids.

In terms of training, Twix will benefit from support with housetraining and ongoing positive reinforcement to help her settle into her new home smoothly.

She has no known allergies or intolerances and does not require any medication at present.

Currently under the care of Rbu – Meadow Of Hope Dog Rescue UK, Twix’s adoption process will involve an application and necessary checks to ensure she finds a suitable and loving forever home.

name: Lola
description:
Meet Lola, a bundle of squishy love at approximately 7 months old, captured in all her playful glory in the picture below. Lola is a loving, active, and spirited pup who delights in running, jumping, and playing throughout the day.

Her exuberance is contagious, but it’s important to note that Lola can get quite excited and jump up, making her more suitable for a home without small children.

In search of an experienced and active home, Lola thrives on interaction and companionship, preferring not to be left alone for extended periods.

Having been abandoned by her sisters when she was tiny, Lola has yet to experience life in a house, making her journey to a forever home a special one that requires patience and positive guidance.

Lola, a Croatian hunting dog mix, would appreciate a home without little furries to chase. She has no reservations about men or women and can coexist with dog-savvy children aged 16 and above.

Described by her carers as confident, friendly, and comfortable with other dogs and visitors, Lola is a joy to have around. She walks well on a lead and cherishes moments of cuddling.

Currently residing in Croatia, Lola is ready to embark on a new chapter of her life in the UK through Rescue Backup (RBU). Vaccinated, blood-tested, flea, and worm-treated, and microchipped, Lola is well-prepared for the journey.

If you’re ready to welcome Lola into your heart and home, an application and checks are part of the process, ensuring a harmonious match between Lola and her future family.

name: Julie
description:
Julie is a 1 year old female Cross-Breed, medium/small in size, currently located in Romania.

She was abandoned in a cardboard box along with 4 newborns on the sidewalk of a road in the town of Tecuci in Romania on 25/05/2024.

A lady asked for help with them, and although we already have a lot of animals in care, we couldn’t bear to leave them there.

Julie is a perfect mother, caring and affectionate. She has a very gentle, kind, and submissive character; she likes to be cuddled and petted.

She can live, after a gradual introduction, with other dogs and children aged 10+. Unfortunately, there is not enough information about how she interacts with cats.

Adopting a dog is a very big decision, so please make sure you are ready for the challenge and commitment.

Are you ready to take care of her? Pay her vet bills? Feed her? Walk her? Consider her a family member for the rest of her life?

If so, we’d love to hear from you! RBU – Meadow Of Hope Dog Rescue UK.

name: Bleki
description:
Introducing Bleki, a delightful female dog awaiting her forever home.

At 2 years old, Bleki is a beautiful Lab/Hound cross currently residing in Bosnia. Despite her past, Bleki is in excellent health and has been fully vaccinated, blood tested, flea and worm treated, microchipped, and spayed.

Bleki’s loving personality has won over the hearts of everyone at the shelter where she resides. Known for her easygoing nature and calm demeanor, Bleki serves as a positive influence on her more energetic companions.

She exudes confidence and affection, readily seeking out cuddles and enjoying being groomed and stroked.

Bleki is well-behaved on the lead and thoroughly enjoys her walks, where she can indulge in the joy of exploration. She gets along well with other dogs and is good with children.

However, she has not been tested with cats. Bleki’s ideal home would provide her with plenty of love, attention, and opportunities for outdoor adventures.

Please note that upon arrival in the UK, Bosnian dogs such as Bleki are required to quarantine in UK kennels for 48 hours before being able to join their new families.

If you’re interested in providing Bleki with the loving home she deserves, please submit an application through Rbu- Meadow Of Hope Dog Rescue UK. Application and checks are part of the adoption process to ensure Bleki finds the perfect match.

name: Medena
description:
Medena, a stunning female dog, is looking for her forever home. Estimated to be around 1-2 years old, Medena is of medium size and boasts a cross breed heritage.

Her current residence is in Bosnia, but she dreams of finding a loving family to explore the world with. Despite her beauty, Medena’s exuberant personality makes her better suited to homes with children aged 13 and above, and she has not been tested with cats.

At the shelter, Medena stands out as one of the most beautiful dogs, and she certainly knows it! She thrives on attention and is at her happiest when she’s out of her kennel, whether it’s for a walk or playtime.

With her intelligence and quick learning ability, Medena is eager to please and would benefit from continued training in a loving home environment.

Medena’s ideal home would provide her with the guidance of a confident older dog and owners committed to continuing her training.

Managing her arousal levels and ensuring she receives plenty of exercise and mental stimulation are crucial for her well-being. Vaccinated, blood tested, flea and worm treated, microchipped, and spayed, Medena is ready to embark on her new life adventure.

Upon arrival in the UK, Medena, like other Bosnian dogs, will need to quarantine in UK kennels for 48 hours before joining her new family.

If you believe you can offer Medena the loving and supportive home she deserves, please consider submitting an application through Rbu – Meadow Of Hope Dog Rescue UK.

Application and checks are necessary steps in the adoption process to ensure Medena finds the perfect match.

name: Frodo
description:
Frodo, a male crossbreed dog of approximately 1-2 years old, is eagerly searching for his forever home.

This medium-sized cross breed pup, currently residing in Bosnia, is known for his gentle and placid nature. Despite not being cat-tested, Frodo loves the company of other dogs and is excellent with calm and sensible children.

At the shelter, Frodo is a beloved favorite, often found curled up under the desk in the office, seeking affection from shelter staff. He enjoys strokes, cuddles, and the companionship of both humans and fellow canines.

Although he may initially be nervous, especially since he has spent most of his life in the shelter, Frodo quickly gains confidence with love and attention. Once he forms a bond with you, he becomes your loyal and affectionate best friend.

Frodo is described as affectionate, loyal, and eager to please. He is making great progress with his training and is keen to learn and adapt to his new environment.

Fully vaccinated, blood tested, flea and worm treated, neutered, and microchipped, Frodo is ready to embark on his new life adventure.

Upon arrival in the UK, Frodo, like other Bosnian dogs, will need to quarantine in UK kennels for 48 hours before joining his new family.

If you’re interested in giving Frodo the loving home he deserves, please consider submitting an application through Rbu – Meadow Of Hope Dog Rescue UK.

Application and checks are part of the adoption process to ensure Frodo finds the perfect match.

name: Snoopy
description:
Snoopy, a charming male Hound Cross puppy of just 3 months old, is eagerly seeking a loving family to call his own.

This medium-sized Hound cross was found abandoned in the bushes and brought to the shelter, but despite his rocky start, Snoopy’s happy-go-lucky nature shines through.

Lonely in the shelter, Snoopy longs for companionship and a warm home environment where he can thrive.

Despite his young age, Snoopy exudes confidence and affection.

He adores playtime, with tug being his favorite game, and he eagerly interacts with other dogs and people alike.

Snoopy’s loving nature extends to children, and he is currently working on being calm around them. As he is still in the early stages of his life, Snoopy is open to being socialized with cats at the shelter.

Snoopy’s delightful personality makes him an ideal addition to any loving home. He is vaccinated, blood tested, flea and worm treated, and microchipped, with neutering pending due to his age.

Upon arrival in the UK, Snoopy, like other Bosnian dogs, will need to quarantine in UK kennels for 48 hours before joining his new family.

If you’re ready to open your heart and home to Snoopy, please consider submitting an application through Rbu – Meadow Of Hope Dog Rescue UK.

Application and checks are part of the adoption process to ensure Snoopy finds the perfect match.

name: Bianka
description:
Bianka, a delightful female cross breed dog of approximately 1 year old, is eagerly seeking her forever home.

This medium-sized sweetheart, currently located in Bosnia, has a charming and playful nature that captures the hearts of everyone she meets.

Bianka’s playful spirit ensures she’s always in the midst of any fun happening at the shelter, enthusiastically engaging with her friends and toys alike.

Although initially shy around strangers, Bianka transforms into a confident and affectionate companion once she’s out of her kennel.

She thrives in the company of other dogs and children, showcasing her adaptability and gentle nature.

Bianka’s potential shines brightest in a loving home environment, where she can continue to blossom with the support of another dog and ongoing training to build her confidence.

Fully vaccinated, blood tested, flea and worm treated, spayed, and microchipped, Bianka is ready to embark on her new life journey.

If you’re ready to provide Bianka with the loving and nurturing home she deserves, please consider submitting an application through Rbu – Meadow Of Hope Dog Rescue UK.

Application and checks are part of the adoption process to ensure Bianka finds the perfect match.

name: Marta
description:
Marta, a delightful 1-year-old female Cross-Breed, is eagerly awaiting her forever family through Meadow Of Hope Dog Rescue UK.

Despite her challenging beginnings—being discovered abandoned with her siblings, malnourished and frightened—Marta has blossomed into a confident and loving companion.

She’s an absolute snugglebug, finding comfort in being by your side or nestled on your lap. Marta’s affection knows no bounds; she showers love and warmth upon anyone willing to reciprocate.

Her resilient spirit and unwavering love for everyone and everything showcase her remarkable character. Marta dreams of a family with children to cuddle and play with, providing her with the love and security she craves.

This sweet girl embodies gentleness and playfulness, making her an ideal addition to any household. She’s good-natured, easygoing, and eager to please, displaying a genuine desire for affection and companionship.

Marta’s suitability with children, cats, and dogs further underscores her adaptable and sociable nature. Currently residing in Bosnia, Marta awaits her chance to find a loving home.

Prospective adopters will need to undergo an application process and checks through Meadow Of Hope Dog Rescue UK.

Additionally, it’s important to note that Bosnian dogs, like Marta, must undergo a 48-hour quarantine in UK kennels upon arrival before traveling home.

name: Flora
description:
Flora is a mature mioritic, born approximately in 2016, and she is a female residing in Romania. She is associated with the Meadow Of Hope Dog Rescue UK and has received vaccinations such as Dhppirl and Nobivac KC.

Flora has undergone thorough blood tests, including screening for brucellosis, and has been diligently treated for fleas and worms. Additionally, she is microchipped and spayed under the care of veterinary professionals.

Beneath her outer layer, Flora possesses a charming spirit that longs to gain the trust of others. The belief is that she will flourish in a home with the correct and knowledgeable environment.

Much like a lovely flower, Flora requires time to blossom, and she is undeniably putting in the effort to do so.

Flora, along with her brother, was rescued from the Breasta public shelter in Romania. Their initial ordeal involved huddling together in a kennel corner for comfort, possibly reflecting the trauma of running for their lives.

Fortunately, they found refuge in a private shelter, though Flora’s brother sadly succumbed to natural causes shortly after their arrival.

Currently cohabiting with other dogs, Flora exhibits amicable relations with her fellow canines. While she remains a bit reserved with people, her progress in the private shelter has been notable.

The ideal home for Flora is one that patiently nurtures bonds with her, avoiding situations that may induce discomfort. Adaptation to leash walking is also a gradual process for Flora, as she hasn’t experienced it yet.

A breed-specific residence with ample free space is deemed suitable for her.

Despite her initial reservations, Flora’s true joy shines through when she feels at ease. Described as large, energetic, and fun, she awaits a compassionate individual who can offer her the home and understanding she requires.

If you believe you could be the person to provide Flora with the right environment, the adoption process involves an application and necessary checks. We look forward to hearing from potential adopters who can provide Flora with the loving home she deserves.

name: Albie
description:
Albie is a 5 year old male Cross-Breed. He was adopted through us several years ago but his family have had a baby and Albie isn’t coping.

Albie has moved out to a relative’s home but this is only a temporary solution and he needs to find a new home as soon as possible.

Albie is a very sweet, loving boy who just needs an adult-only home where someone is around a lot of the day (although is fine to be left for a few hours).

Albie has a secure garden and places nearby where he can be walked without too many dogs in his face as he is a little lead reactive (this can improve with positive reinforcement and time).

Albie is a nice boy who is at that great age with lots of life left, energy enough for long walks but able to relax when at home.

name: Sadie
description:
Sadie is a 6-7 year old female Boxer Cross. She is very loving, friendly, and playful. She loves running through fields and playing in streams. She also loves to play with other dogs.

Sadie can be strong on the lead, especially if she sees another dog so does need someone strong enough to hold her.

Sadie has lived both as an only dog and as part of a pack. She cannot be homed with cats and any resident children need to be dog respectful 12+.
